item.title: Speyside MP Invites Scottish Labour MPs to Whisky Tasting Over Tax Row
item.description: Speyside MP Graham Leadbitter has invited Scottish Labour MPs to a whisky tasting at Westminster, urging them to reflect on Labour’s whisky tax hikes and the impact on Scotland’s most valuable export industry.The post Speyside MP Invites Scottish Labour MPs to Whisky Tasting Over Tax Row appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Coastal Home With Sea Views and Space to Breathe Near Dervaig
item.description: Set near Dervaig on the Isle of Mull, this coastal home offers sea views, generous land, and a separate chalet, creating a flexible and peaceful base for island living with space to adapt over time.The post A Coastal Home With Sea Views and Space to Breathe Near Dervaig appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Two Moray Community Councils Re Established After Rerun Elections
item.description: Two Moray community councils in Buckie and Findochty have been successfully re established after rerun elections, following a renewed call for local residents to step forward and help represent their communities.The post Two Moray Community Councils Re Established After Rerun Elections appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Holyrood Candidate Says NHS Progress is Being Made and Doom Mongering Must Stop
item.description: An SNP Holyrood candidate has accused opposition figures of doom mongering on the NHS, pointing to falling waiting lists, record health funding, and improving performance at NHS Highland as evidence that progress is being made.The post Holyrood Candidate Says NHS Progress is Being Made and Doom Mongering Must Stop appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Gordon Docherty Jailed for 12 Years After Serious Sexual Offences in Orkney
item.description: Gordon Docherty has been sentenced to 12 years in prison for serious sexual offences committed in Orkney, with police thanking the victims for their courage and reiterating that both historic and recent abuse will be investigated and prosecuted.The post Gordon Docherty Jailed for 12 Years After Serious Sexual Offences in Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Young People From The Highlands Urged to Change The World One Step at a Time
item.description: Young people from the Highlands are being invited to apply to become Young Advisors with Scotland’s Children and Young People’s Commissioner, helping shape children’s rights work at home and internationally while making a real difference one step at a time.The post Young People From The Highlands Urged to Change The World One Step at a Time appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Europe’s First Corvette ZR1 Supercars Arrive in The UK
item.description: Europe’s first new Corvette ZR1 supercars have arrived in the UK via Clive Sutton, with the ultra rare 1,064 bhp models marking a major moment for American performance cars on European roads and demand already exceeding supply.The post Europe’s First Corvette ZR1 Supercars Arrive in The UK appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highlands MSP Calls for Honest Conversation on Bringing Lynx Back to Scotland
item.description: A Highlands and Islands MSP has called for an open and respectful debate on the possible return of lynx to Scotland, urging farmers, scientists, communities, and government to examine both the benefits and challenges before any decisions are made.The post Highlands MSP Calls for Honest Conversation on Bringing Lynx Back to Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Convicted of Culpable Homicide After Oban Ambulance Death
item.description: A man has been convicted of culpable homicide following the death of Robert Bromell after an incident involving a moving ambulance in Oban, with the court hearing how a sudden act of violence led to lasting loss for a family and community.The post Man Convicted of Culpable Homicide After Oban Ambulance Death appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Warn of Hazardous Travel as Heavy Rain Moves into Highlands and Islands
item.description: Police Scotland has warned of hazardous travel across the Highlands and Islands as heavy rain moves in, with flooding and transport disruption expected under ongoing weather warnings.The post Police Warn of Hazardous Travel as Heavy Rain Moves into Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.
